#DisabledBlackTalk - all are welcome to observe and support, but it’s Black people talking about #BlackChronicPain tonight.

for 90 minutes

@Mae_DayJ I forget how wise you are and how beautiful you are in screen, despite the fact that you are being a dear friend and advisor every day. 

Thank you so much for being on @TheStayingInn #BlackLivesMatter panel.

Trying to get white people with #BlackLivesMatter in their profile 

to bring that same energy to their everyday actions.
